scope: Local Chrome LFM3 GGUF only. Thinking off except the explicitly marked diagnostic. Small constructed tactical suite; no full-game or general-strength claim.
timingConditions: Elapsed time includes prompt analysis, model loading and warm cache. Separate serial runs; idle existing browser/model contexts remained open. Not a controlled latency comparison.
revisionCaveat: The long-running Vite preview reported its initial 3715ca1+working revision after later edits. Exact embedded system and position prompts are separately rebuilt and verified against the preserved version modules.
